latest.title: Kubernetes at Scale with EKS Auto Mode: One Click to Production AI
latest.description: Amazon EKS Auto Mode lets you go from zero to a production-grade Kubernetes cluster with a single click. No infrastructure expertise required. In this post, we break down what Auto Mode actually does, how it handles AI workloads, and why it might mean you don't need a dedicated platform team.

latest.title: How to Connect Enterprise Systems to Amazon Quick Desktop with MCP
latest.description: This article walks you through connecting enterprise systems (like Salesforce, Jira, or internal databases) to Amazon Quick Desktop using MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering the full setup from adding a local or remote connection to querying data with natural language. It then shows how to go beyond simple lookups by building interactive dashboards from live MCP-sourced data and creating scheduled agents that automatically pull cross-system insights on a recurring basis.

latest.title: From Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering: Building Agents That Actually Work at Scale
latest.description: Building an AI agent that demos well is easy. Keeping it reliable in production is not. When agents break at scale, the model is rarely the problem — what the model receives is. Part 1 of this series introduces context engineering: the discipline of managing what information reaches your agent, when, and in what form — and why it changes everything

latest.title: Building Continuous Compliance on AWS: A Practical, System-Level Approach
latest.description: A practical, system-level approach to implementing continuous compliance on AWS using preventive guardrails, real-time detection, and automated remediation. This article breaks down how modern cloud teams can move from periodic audits to always-on compliance using native AWS services like AWS Organizations, Config, Security Hub, GuardDuty, EventBridge, and CloudTrail.
